title: ocimum fruticosum
intro: Ocimum fruticosum, commonly known as Thoroughwort or Holly Basil, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ocimum fruticosum are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, as well as its ability to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Ocimum fruticosum include phenolic compounds, such as rosmarinic acid and ursolic acid, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
